lessons.summary: A reported delivery failed; a coordinator arranged a confirmed handoff.
lessons.recommendation: Confirm an accessible handoff point with the survivor; verify receipt after delivery.

lessons.summary: A shelter placement reported as arranged did not reach a household without power; a coordinator agreed a check-in point and a callback window.
lessons.recommendation: Agree a check-in point and a callback window with the household before the placement; verify arrival separately.

lessons.summary: A routine prescription pickup was left at a closed access point; after the pickup point was confirmed with the household it was received.
lessons.recommendation: Confirm the pickup point and who will be present before delivery; the group supplies existing prescriptions only and gives no medical advice.

lessons.summary: A temporary repair crew could not reach a site behind a washed-out road; a revisit with a confirmed route completed the work.
lessons.recommendation: Confirm a passable route to the site before dispatching a crew; verify the repair separately afterwards.
